answer: Unfortunately, no. Northwind's home pickup service, where a specialist comes to your home or office to inspect the car and complete the sale, isn't available in Texas. Instead, you can get an instant offer online with your VIN or license plate and then book an appraisal appointment at a store, where a specialist inspects the car and confirms the offer. If your car doesn't run, select stores will tow it to the store at no charge, and your offer page shows which stores near you offer towing.
